terms.comment: Varro derives it from scandere: wrongly, since it is the diminutive of scamnum.

phrases.latin: Ad lābrum Theodōrus, in scabellō stāns, pēniculum dentārium, dentifriciō illitum, ipse tenuit
phrases.english: At the basin, standing on the step stool, Theo held the toothbrush, with the toothpaste on it, himself

sources: Theodōrus et pater · Ad Larem avītum, Libellī I–VII, as they stood on 7 November 2026. Examples marked “Libellus” quote those texts word for word.
